title: The rule controller that drove a third of the logged steps, as an ONNX graph
description: One of the three kinds of controller behind compact's logged step data (experiments/phase0-steps.json): a fixed rule that sets the window to 2^0.25 times the bandwidth-delay product its built-in estimator believes. Regenerating that data needs this exact file, so it is copied byte for byte from the project compact was forked from (source: release model-net1v3 of Radonux/palaestra, file rule-u0.25.onnx; SHA-256 ba480095699ced163672cd774466eec66d6e2a6fe44b46d8d62f62e87bf115ef). It is not teachers/rule-bdp.onnx of experiments/phase0-teachers.json, which is the same rule over a later estimator. The file keeps the name examples/net1_broad.py looks for. summary.md lists its size and SHA-256.
collect: { echo '| file | bytes | sha256 |'; echo '|---|---|---|'; for f in "$OUT"/models/*.onnx; do echo "| models/$(basename "$f") | $(stat -c %s "$f") | $(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1) |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
